payload.name: Preserve Distinct Event Facts on Update
payload.description: When updating an existing event memory with new message content, first check whether the new activity/event is the same as the memory's; if it is a distinct past event, keep the original memory and ADD a new one.
content: During CRUD/update, before replacing an existing memory's content or world_start with new event details, verify that the new message describes the same event (same activity, companions, and timeframe).
If the new event differs in activity, companions, or time, do not UPDATE the existing memory; instead ADD a new memory for the new event and leave the original unchanged.
When uncertain, prefer adding a distinct memory over overwriting; multiple past events with the same subject at different times must coexist.

solves: Prevents construction updates from overwriting an earlier event memory when a later message mentions a different event. The agent should distinguish same-event updates from distinct events and preserve original facts by adding a separate memory.
